signature.instructions: Given a Text prompt, determine the category of the expected answer and output exactly one of the following labels: Description, Entity, Expression, Human, Location, Number. Do not provide the actual answer or any explanation—only the label. The labels correspond to the type of answer the prompt is likely to elicit (e.g., a person -> Human, a year/quantity -> Number, etc.). Ensure concise, deterministic labeling even in the presence of punctuation/formatting noise.
